name: Generate, Simulate, and Select Candidate Strategies

nodes.name: Receive Strategy Evaluation Request
nodes.notes: Receives released TRT and reconciliation context. This workflow never deploys.

nodes.name: Generate Candidate Strategy Batch
nodes.notes: LLM generates multiple schema-constrained candidates. Sampling parameters are not sent.

nodes.name: Start Sequential Candidate Simulations
nodes.notes: The API uses a global lock and runs exactly one Isaac candidate at a time.
